Title: PDF to Text
Description: Extract all text from PDF documents easily in your browser.
Seo_Introduction: The PDF to Text converter is a privacy-first tool that allows you to extract text content from any PDF file directly in your browser.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
This tool uses WebAssembly technology to parse PDF structures and extract text without uploading your files to any server. It supports standard text-based PDF documents and handles various character encodings to ensure accurate extraction.

You can upload multiple PDF files and process them in a batch. Each file will be converted to a plain text (.txt) file that you can download and use for your needs.
Seo_Examples:
**Example 1**: Extract content from a research paper PDF for analysis in a text editor.

**Example 2**: Quickly get text from a PDF invoice or receipt.

**Example 3**: Convert a large PDF ebook into a simple text file for easier reading on low-power devices.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Upload PDF Files
Drag and drop your PDF documents into the tool or click the upload area to select them.

### Step 2: Start Extraction
Click the "Extract Text" button to begin processing all loaded files.

### Step 3: Download Text Files
Once the extraction is complete, click the "Download" icon next to each file to save the resulting .txt document.
Seo_Tips:
- Works completely in the browser for maximum privacy
- Fast and efficient processing using Rust/WASM
- Supports batch processing of multiple files
- No registration or server upload required
